`UA_NotificationMessage` (type 35) has `notificationData` which is an array of `UA_ExtensionObject`. But wait - the fuzz target uses `UA_decodeBinary` on a single type. The `typeIndex` selects the type to decode. If I select `UA_TYPES_NOTIFICATIONMESSAGE` (35), it will decode a `UA_NotificationMessage` which contains an array of ExtensionObjects.

But actually, looking at the fuzz target more carefully, `tortureEncoding` decodes a single type. The `Array_decodeBinary` is called when decoding array members within a struct. So if I use `UA_TYPES_NOTIFICATIONMESSAGE`, the `notificationData` array will be decoded via `Array_decodeBinary` with type `UA_ExtensionObject`.
